title: Combo Attack III - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Combo Attack III in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Combo Attack III is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Increases damage of subsequent hits in a combo.

sections.title: Effect
sections.content: Increases damage of subsequent hits in a combo.

sections.title: How to Get Combo Attack III
Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
